summary: Miyoo's clamshell-form-factor Linux handheld. spruceOS lists it with 'Stable' support status. No KNULLI image available. Hardware specifications not sourced from verified vendor or community pages at the time of check (2026-10-28).

homebrew.summary: Custom frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported Miyoo devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the Miyoo Mini Flip with 'Stable' support status (checked 2026-10-28).

requirements: A compatible Miyoo Mini Flip unit.
A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.
